caption:
Your missed-call text-back might be firing 30 seconds too late.

Most systems don't trigger the moment a call goes unanswered. They wait for the full voicemail cycle: greeting, prompt, hang-up, then the text sends.

A 20-second greeting plus a 10-second prompt burns 30 seconds before your lead sees a word from you. That's enough time to call the next name on their list.

This week, have someone outside your business call your line and time how long the text takes to land.

If it takes longer than 15 seconds, ask your provider whether the trigger fires on the missed call itself or on voicemail completion, then switch it to the faster option.

Speed decides who gets the job.
